description: Live check of a Rust crate against every RustSec/GHSA advisory (OSV) and crates.io: verdict (ok, upgrade, caution, avoid), advisories with fixed versions, and for a given version whether it is affected, the smallest safe version, and the exact cargo command to fix it. Unmaintained crates come with the suggested replacement.
name: crate_check
title: Is this Rust crate safe? Is my version affected?
